path: StarterPlayerScripts/TutorialBeam.client.luau
purpose: Feature: Fix this bug: Make the tutorial advance through claim, first cash-in, Dropper 2 buy, open SHOP, and buy a tier upgrade. Show the arrow and a visible Beam from the player to each target (the census must show beams > 0). Re-show a stuck step's hint after 15s. Fire shop_opened when the SHOP panel opens. Tutorial steps must reach 5+ in a 60s playtest, and the stale step-4 text must match the real action. -- Client-only visuals for the current tutorial target. Watches the TutorialTarget ObjectValue under LocalPlayer and the TutorialStep and TutorialNonce attributes. When the target is a BasePart it builds a bouncing arrow (a Neon part or BillboardGui) above it. It also builds a visible Beam: Attachment0 on the character's HumanoidRootPart, Attachment1 on the target, Width0 and Width1 0.4, LightEmission 1, FaceCamera true, bright Color, Enabled true, Segments 10. The beam and arrow live under a Folder 'TutorialBeam' in Workspace so the census counts beams > 0. Rebuilds on respawn, when the target changes, and when the nonce changes (a short pulse on reshow). On step 4 it also bounces a small BillboardGui arrow over the SHOP button, found by searching PlayerGui for a button whose text contains 'SHOP'. Clears everything at step 6. Sends nothing to the server. Uses UiTheme for colors and TutorialConfig. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: tutorial_steps, shop_opened, tutorial_reshown, tutorial_done.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/TutorialConfig.luau, ReplicatedStorage/UiTheme.luau

```luau
-- Pure shared tunables for the first-60-seconds tutorial.
-- No side effects: this ModuleScript only returns a table.

local TutorialConfig = {
	TOTAL_SECONDS = 60,
	SKIP_UPGRADES = 3,

	REMOTE_NAME = "TutorialStep",

	EVENTS = {
		START = "start",
		CLAIMED = "claimed",
		CASHED = "cashed",
		BOUGHT = "bought",
		SKIP = "skip",
	},

	-- Banner text per step (index = step number).
	STEPS = {
		"Walk to a CLAIM gate to claim your plot",
		"Watch your dropper make cash",
		"Step on the glowing GREEN pad: $10",
		"Tap the yellow SHOP button, buy Fast Belt!",
	},

	-- Which server event advances away from each step.
	-- step 1 -> 'claimed', step 2 -> timed fallback (ADVANCE_DELAY, no waiting for a cash event),
	-- step 3 -> 'bought', step 4 -> ends when the shop opens.
	ADVANCE_ON = {
		"claimed",
		"claimed",
		"bought",
		"shop",
	},

	-- Seconds to wait after entering a step before it auto-advances (keyed by step number).
	-- Step 2 advances ~8 s after entering it even if no cash event ever arrives,
	-- so the player is never left without guidance.
	ADVANCE_DELAY = {
		[2] = 8,
	},

	-- Timed fallback (seconds) used when an expected server event never arrives.
	-- Keyed by step number; step 2 -> step 3 after about 8 seconds.
	FALLBACK_DELAY = {
		[2] = 8,
	},

	-- Seconds after the shop step begins before the client pulses the SHOP button

	SHOP_NUDGE_SECONDS = 8,

	STEP_SOUND = "Pop",

	ARROW_STEPS = {

	ARROW_SIZE = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3),
	ARROW_HEIGHT = 11, -- studs above target

	BOUNCE_SPEED = 4, -- radians per second

	-- Beam from player to target.
	BEAM_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 120),
	BEAM_WIDTH = 1,

	-- Banner visuals.
	BANNER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 50),
	BANNER_TEXT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	BANNER_STROKE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 221, 51),
}

-- Convenience lookups.
TutorialConfig.EVENT_NAMES = {
```

```luau
--!strict
-- UiTheme: pure shared UI kit for the house Theme (no side effects, no server code).
-- Palette matches the HUD / cash look: yellow Primary, green Good, red Bad, blue Info, dark Ink outlines.
-- Telemetry (shop_opened, shop_purchases) is counted by the server-side owner of those events, not here.

local UiTheme = {}

-- Colors
UiTheme.ink = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.cream = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.panel = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.card = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
UiTheme.text = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 41)
UiTheme.good = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92)
UiTheme.bad = Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
UiTheme.info = Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 255)
UiTheme.dim = Color3.fromRGB(190, 184, 176)
UiTheme.locked = Color3.fromRGB(120, 112, 134)

-- Fonts and metrics
UiTheme.font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
UiTheme.headerFont = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
UiTheme.cornerRadius = 14
UiTheme.stroke = 3
UiTheme.minButtonHeight = 48 -- at least 44 px touch target
UiTheme.padding = 10

-- Adds a UICorner to a GuiObject (reuses an existing one).
function UiTheme.roundify(guiObject: GuiObject, radius: number?)
	local corner = guiObject:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.Parent = guiObject
	end
	(corner :: UICorner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or UiTheme.cornerRadius)
end

-- Returns a big readable TextButton.
-- props: text, size, position, anchorPoint, color, textColor, parent, name, zIndex, layoutOrder, onClick
function UiTheme.makeButton(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = props.name or "Button"
	button.Text = props.text or ""
	local size: UDim2 = props.size or UDim2.fromOffset(160, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	if size.Y.Offset < UiTheme.minButtonHeight and size.Y.Scale == 0 then
		size = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	end
	button.Size = size
	button.Position = props.position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	button.AnchorPoint = props.anchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = props.color or UiTheme.accent
	button.TextColor3 = props.textColor or UiTheme.cream
	button.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.ZIndex = props.zIndex or 1
	button.LayoutOrder = props.layoutOrder or 0

	UiTheme.roundify(button, UiTheme.cornerRadius)

	local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	border.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	border.Color = UiTheme.ink
	border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	border.Parent = button

	local textStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	textStroke.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	textStroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	textStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	textStroke.Parent = button

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.Parent = button

	local minSize = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	minSize.MinSize = Vector2.new(44, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	minSize.Parent = button

	local onClick = props.onClick
	if typeof(onClick) == "function" then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			onClick()
		end)
	end

	if props.parent then
		button.Parent = props.parent
	end
	return button
end

return UiTheme
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.
- Budget the whole first-payout path, not just the claim: claim delay + first spawn + conveyor travel (length / speed) should land the first cash-in within about 3-4s of the claim. Use a short, fast conveyor, spawn the first item immediately on claim, and don't leave this borderline.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds). Tutorial steps must be advanced by events that actually occur, or the player is left without guidance. Add a time-based fallback so a step can't stall. Make the steps lead the player to every key feature (buy pad, shop), and check that the guide beam or arrow actually appears (its census count is above 0).
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.
- Shared effect helpers (burst, shake, sound, FOV punch) only matter if gameplay code calls them. Wire each helper to a real event (collect, buy, rebirth, big upgrade) and check that its counter is above 0 after a playtest. Big moments deserve stronger feedback than routine ones: camera shake, a shockwave ring, or a larger popup.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Bump an effect counter (sound, burst, popup) where the effect is really created, not where the remote is fired. If the counter is high but the census shows 0 sounds or bursts, the effects are not real or are destroyed before they are counted. Fix the effect, don't trust the counter.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value; a counter at 2x its expected value (e.g. 12 vs 6, or 2 claims for 1 player) means a double init, double build or duplicate timer, so check for it.
- Do not put telemetry or build side effects at the top level of a ModuleScript that is shared (e.g. a data module in ReplicatedStorage). Module top-level code can run once per environment or require path. Count inside the single builder function that the entry script calls once.
- Each builder/init function must be called exactly once from the entry script. If two modules both build the same thing (e.g. plaza and plot builders both building themes), assign ownership to one.
- Never call warn() or error() for expected situations such as a duplicate-startup guard. Warnings in the output fail "no errors or warnings" checks. Return silently or use print.

```luau
--!strict
-- TutorialBeam (client): arrow + Beam to the current tutorial target, plus a SHOP button arrow on step 4.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local TutorialConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TutorialConfig"))
local UiTheme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UiTheme"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local RESHOW_AFTER = 15
local LAST_STEP = 5

local HINTS: { [number]: string } = {
	[1] = "Walk to a CLAIM gate!",
	[2] = "Watch your dropper make cash!",
	[3] = "Step on the glowing pad: $10",
	[4] = "Tap the yellow SHOP button!",
	[5] = "Buy an upgrade in the SHOP!",
}

-- Telemetry (a no-op on the client, wrapped so it can never error).
local telemetry: any = nil
task.spawn(function()
	local ok, mod = pcall(function()
		local inst = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 5)
		if inst then
			return require(inst)
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if ok then
		telemetry = mod
	end
end)
local function count(name: string)
	if telemetry and typeof(telemetry.count) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			telemetry.count(name, 1)
		end)
	end
end

local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("TutorialBeam")
if not folder then
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "TutorialBeam"
	f.Parent = Workspace
	folder = f
end
local worldFolder = folder :: Folder

local arrowPart: BasePart? = nil
local targetPart: BasePart? = nil
local attachments: { Attachment } = {}
local shopGui: ScreenGui? = nil
local shopArrow: TextLabel? = nil
local shopButton: GuiObject? = nil
local shopConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local targetConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local boundValue: ObjectValue? = nil

local currentStep = 0
local lastStepSeen = -1
local lastNonce: any = nil
local lastChange = os.clock()
local pulseUntil = 0
local doneCounted = false
local shopCounted = false
local lastShopSearch = 0

local function clearWorld()
	for _, a in ipairs(attachments) do
		a:Destroy()
	end
	attachments = {}
	worldFolder:ClearAllChildren()
	arrowPart = nil
	targetPart = nil
end

local function clearShop()
	if shopConn then
		shopConn:Disconnect()
		shopConn = nil
	end
	if shopGui then
		shopGui:Destroy()
		shopGui = nil
	end
	shopArrow = nil
	shopButton = nil
end

local function resolveTarget(): BasePart?
	local tv = player:FindFirstChild("TutorialTarget")
	if not tv or not tv:IsA("ObjectValue") then
		return nil
	end
	local v = tv.Value
	if v and v:IsA("BasePart") then
		return v
	end
	if v and v:IsA("Model") then
		if v.PrimaryPart then
			return v.PrimaryPart
		end
		return v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildWorld(target: BasePart)
	targetPart = target
	local arrow = Instance.new("Part")
	arrow.Name = "TutorialArrow"
	arrow.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	arrow.Size = TutorialConfig.ARROW_SIZE
	arrow.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	arrow.Color = TutorialConfig.ARROW_COLOR
	arrow.Anchored = true
	arrow.CanCollide = false
	arrow.CanQuery = false
	arrow.CanTouch = false
	arrow.CastShadow = false
	arrow.CFrame = CFrame.new(target.Position + Vector3.new(0, TutorialConfig.ARROW_HEIGHT, 0))

	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Hint"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 60)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Adornee = arrow
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.ink
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	label.TextColor3 = UiTheme.accent
	label.Font = UiTheme.font
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Text = HINTS[currentStep] or TutorialConfig.STEPS[currentStep] or ""
	UiTheme.roundify(label, 12)
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = arrow
	arrow.Parent = worldFolder
	arrowPart = arrow

	local character = player.Character
	local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a0.Name = "TutorialBeamStart"
		a0.Parent = hrp
		local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a1.Name = "TutorialBeamEnd"
		a1.Parent = target
		attachments = { a0, a1 }

		local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
		beam.Name = "TutorialBeamLine"
		beam.Attachment0 = a0
		beam.Attachment1 = a1
		beam.Width0 = 0.4
		beam.Width1 = 0.4
		beam.LightEmission = 1
		beam.FaceCamera = true
		beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(TutorialConfig.BEAM_COLOR)
		beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
		beam.Segments = 10
		beam.Enabled = true
		beam.Parent = worldFolder
	end
end

local function findShopButton(): GuiObject?
	local pg = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then
		return nil
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextButton") and string.find(string.upper(d.Text), "SHOP", 1, true) then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildShopArrow(button: GuiObject)
	clearShop()
	local pg = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not pg then
		return
	end
	local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	sg.Name = "TutorialShopArrow"
	sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
	sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	sg.DisplayOrder = 50
	local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	arrow.Name = "ShopArrow"
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
	arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 50)
	arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	arrow.Text = "▼"
	arrow.TextScaled = true
	arrow.Font = UiTheme.font
	arrow.TextColor3 = UiTheme.accent
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	stroke.Parent = arrow
	arrow.Parent = sg
	sg.Parent = pg
	shopGui = sg
	shopArrow = arrow
	shopButton = button
	if button:IsA("GuiButton") then
		shopConn = button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if currentStep == 4 and not shopCounted then
				shopCounted = true
				count("shop_opened")
			end
			clearShop()
		end)
	end
end

local function rebuild(pulse: boolean)
	clearWorld()
	clearShop()
	if currentStep < 1 or currentStep > LAST_STEP then
		return
	end
	if pulse then
		pulseUntil = os.clock() + 1.2
	end
	local target = resolveTarget()
	if target and target:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		buildWorld(target)
	end
	if currentStep == 4 then
		local b = findShopButton()
		if b then
			buildShopArrow(b)
		end
	end
end

local function bindTarget()
	local tv = player:FindFirstChild("TutorialTarget")
	if tv and tv:IsA("ObjectValue") and tv ~= boundValue then
		if targetConn then
			targetConn:Disconnect()
		end
		boundValue = tv
		targetConn = tv:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			rebuild(false)
		end)
		rebuild(false)
	end
end

local function onStep()
	local s = player:GetAttribute("TutorialStep")
	if typeof(s) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	if s == lastStepSeen then
		return
	end
	lastStepSeen = s
	currentStep = s
	lastChange = os.clock()
	count("tutorial_steps")
	if s > LAST_STEP and not doneCounted then
		doneCounted = true
		count("tutorial_done")
	end
	if s == 4 then
		shopCounted = false
	end
	rebuild(false)
end

local function onNonce()
	local n = player:GetAttribute("TutorialNonce")
	if n == lastNonce then
		return
	end
	local first = lastNonce == nil
	lastNonce = n
	if first then
		return
	end
	lastChange = os.clock()
	if currentStep >= 1 and currentStep <= LAST_STEP then
		count("tutorial_reshown")
		rebuild(true)
	end
end

player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TutorialStep"):Connect(onStep)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TutorialNonce"):Connect(onNonce)
player.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	task.defer(bindTarget)
end)

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	task.spawn(function()
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		rebuild(false)
	end)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
if player.Character then
	onCharacter(player.Character)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local now = os.clock()
	local arrow = arrowPart
	local target = targetPart
```
